_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil statistics and absent 24h macro catalyst make HOLD the base-rate call; Denial holds while fear_greed stays 25-38 and funding flat.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Denial; analyst explicitly forwards HOLD, narrative silent on direction so defaults to analyst
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains range-bound, fear_greed 25-38, funding near flat through weekend
next_move.invalidated_if: Fast flush (fear_greed <20, negative funding, spot breakdown) to Panic, or flow-backed reclaim (ETF inflows + fear_greed >45) to Anxiety
